name: Magyarmecske (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a green cross, charged at the crossing with the municipal arms of Magyarmecske (a red shield with a white bird, with a helm and red and white mantling).
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Magyarmecske arms with helm and mantling
